newsitem.title: USA: Medical Graphics sees restructuring benefits in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Medical Graphics sees restructuring benefits in Q2.

text.p: Medical Graphics Corp said Thursday it expects to begin to see the benefits of its restructuring plan during the second quarter.
"Although there remains much work to do, we are pleased with these initial indications that the turnaround plan is progressing," chairman Mark Sheffert said in a statement.
"We believe we have reversed the negative trends from the fourth quarter of last year, and will now begin to realize the benefits of our restructuring plan in the second quarter," he said.
Sheffert said re-financing arrangements are complete, the new management team is in place, and the company is focused on its core business and on creating shareholder value.
Medical Graphics reported a first quarter loss of $0.91 a share including a one-time restructuring charge of $0.52, versus a loss of $0.24 for the period last year.
The company said the gross margin was 32 percent for the quarter, lower than the 40 percent in first quarter 1996 but higher than the negative 22 percent in fourth quarter 1996.
Medical Graphics provides non-invasive cardiorespiratory diagnostic systems.
